actions.text: Pressing save on the settings page saves the media management settings and the naming settings together.
Editing any field records a pending change that is saved only on save.
Pressing '?' next to a naming format field opens the token modal for that format (standard, daily, anime, series folder, season folder, specials folder).
Clicking a token in the naming modal inserts it at the caret (or appends it); a full-filename preset replaces the whole value.
'Add Root Folder' opens a file browser; confirming with Ok adds the chosen path as a root folder.
The file browser lists directories and files from the file system; selecting a row navigates to it, and Cancel or Ok close it.
Each root folder row has an 'Import' button (hidden when unavailable) and a remove button that opens a confirmation modal before deleting.

rules.text: The Folders and Importing sections, and advanced rows, appear only when advanced settings are shown.
The Permissions section (Set Permissions, chmod folder, chown group) appears only when advanced settings are shown and the system is not Windows.
The import script path appears only when 'Import Using Script' is checked; the extra file extensions field appears only when 'Import Extra Files' is checked.
The season pack upgrade threshold field appears only when season pack upgrade is 'threshold'; it is a percent from 0 to 100 in steps of 0.01, with examples shown.
Threshold examples are not shown if the threshold is not a number or is outside 0 to 100.
Warnings show when season pack upgrade is 'any' and when Download Propers and Repacks is 'doNotPrefer'.
Minimum free space is a number in MB; Recycling Bin Cleanup days is a number with minimum 0.
The Standard, Daily and Anime episode format fields appear only when Rename Episodes is on.
Colon Replacement appears only when Replace Illegal Characters is on, and the custom colon replacement field only when its value is 5 (Custom).
Series Folder Format and Specials Folder Format rows are advanced-only.
Naming examples are requested with the naming settings debounced by 300 ms.
The token modal's default separator is a space and default capitalization is 'title'; lower or upper capitalization changes the inserted token's case.
Presets appear only for episode formats; daily and anime presets and absolute-number tokens only for those types; season tokens only when season or season title applies.
The file browser shows a mapped network drives warning on Windows when running as a service.
Settings validation errors and warnings from a 400 save response are attached to the matching field by property name.

shows.text: The page is titled 'Media Management Settings' and has a heading 'Media Management' under the scope 'Settings'.
While settings load, a loading indicator is shown in a 'Naming Settings' field set; if loading fails, a danger alert 'MediaManagementSettingsLoadError' is shown there instead.

The 'Episode Naming' section shows checkboxes 'Rename Episodes' and 'Replace Illegal Characters', plus a Multi Episode Style select with options Extend, Duplicate, Repeat, Scene, Range and Prefixed Range, each with an example hint.
The Episode Naming section shows a loading indicator while fetching and a danger alert if naming settings fail to load.
Naming format fields show example output as help text, or an invalid-format error when the server returns no example for that format.

The File Management section shows: Unmonitor Deleted Episodes, Download Propers and Repacks, Analyse Video Files, Rescan Series Folder After Refresh, Change File Date, Recycling Bin, and Recycling Bin Cleanup.
A Root Folders section lists each root folder with its path, a count of folders to import or 'nothing to import', and free space when known.
A root folder row shows an 'Unavailable' badge when not accessible, or an 'Empty' badge when empty.
The root folder list shows a loading indicator on first load and a danger alert 'RootFoldersLoadError' on error.
If adding a root folder fails, an alert lists the error messages returned.
The naming token modal is titled 'File Name Tokens' for episode formats and 'Folder Name Tokens' otherwise, and shows grouped tokens with examples, separator and capitalization selects.

sideEffects.text: Saving writes the settings with a PUT to the settings path and clears pending changes on success.
Adding a root folder POSTs the path to the root folder API and adds the result to the cached list.
Confirming removal sends a DELETE for the root folder and refreshes the root folder list.
Naming examples are fetched with a GET to the naming examples endpoint using the current naming values.
